MOB_TORCH_VILLAGER.name: Torch Villager
MOB_TORCH_VILLAGER.lore: Brought a torch to a necromancer fight. Bold.

MOB_PITCHFORK_FARMER.name: Pitchfork Farmer
MOB_PITCHFORK_FARMER.lore: Farms by day, forks by night.

MOB_LANTERN_WATCHMAN.name: Lantern Watchman
MOB_LANTERN_WATCHMAN.lore: Counts the hours and the skeletons. Loses count of both.

CHAMP_GUARD_CAPTAIN.name: Guard Captain
CHAMP_GUARD_CAPTAIN.lore: Polished helmet, red plume, no sense of humour.

CHAMP_MONSTER_HUNTER.name: Monster Hunter
CHAMP_MONSTER_HUNTER.lore: Twelve stakes on the belt, three of them sharp.

BOSS_EXORCIST.name: The Exorcist
BOSS_EXORCIST.lore: Splashes holy water on anything that rattles, including the plumbing.

BOSS_BELL_RINGER.name: The Bell Ringer
BOSS_BELL_RINGER.lore: Rings the great bell until something gets stuck. Usually a die.

BOSS_INQUISITOR.name: The Inquisitor
BOSS_INQUISITOR.lore: Asks many questions. Accepts one fewer summon as an answer.

EXORCIST.name: Holy Water
EXORCIST.effect: Holy Water: BONE dice score 0 points.

WITCH_HUNTER.name: Confiscation
WITCH_HUNTER.effect: Confiscation: your leftmost trinket is disabled.

BELL_RINGER.name: Toll
BELL_RINGER.effect: Toll: after every roll and reroll, 1 random die is shackled.
